auto_insurance_renewal.pdf.title: Auto insurance — Brightline
auto_insurance_renewal.pdf.summary: Your car insurance auto-renews on Dec 12, 2026 at $1,676 — $256 (18%) more than this year — and will be charged to your Visa unless you act first.

items.label: Policy auto-renews 18% higher
items.why: The renewal premium jumps from $1,420 to $1,676 and is charged automatically. Cancelling after renewal costs a 10% short-rate fee, so the cheap window is before Dec 12. At risk = the $256 increase.
items.action: Get 2–3 quotes for the same coverage and ask Brightline to match or lower the renewal price

$60 policy fee included in the premium
